research_methodology_amendment.amendment_name: Provider Integrity, Offline Replay, and Stage-B Validation Invariants
research_methodology_amendment.supersedes_prior_rule: Supersedes CORR-002 unproven Stage-B usability logic, absent raw OHLCV replay persistence, and unvalidated provider payload integrity.

practical_principles.principle_a: Distinguish verified provider-reported absence of prints from provider failures. Never convert a failed or malformed request into zero volume or valid no-trade observations.
practical_principles.principle_b: Retain externally supported ORB strategy (Zarattini et al., 2024) as a permanent research candidate regardless of independent evaluation outcomes.
practical_principles.principle_c: Enforce deterministic offline replay from cryptographically verified raw provider evidence without credentials or network access.

rules: HTTP status must be 200 with completed pagination (no cycle, no repeated token, no truncated pages).
Response symbol identities must strictly match requested batch queries without unexpected symbols.
Timestamps must be non-null, validly formatted, strictly within session window, and free of duplicate timestamps per symbol.
OHLCV values must be strictly positive prices, non-negative volume, finite, and obey bounds (high >= max(open, close), low <= min(open, close), high >= low).
Failed, truncated, or corrupt payloads fail closed as PROVIDER_DATA_FAILURE.
Persist replayable provider evidence for every stage: Dec 2023 daily bars, Jan 2 opening range (09:30-09:34 ET), 14 prior sessions opening range, and Jan 2 Stage-B minute bars (09:35-15:59 ET).
Preserve response/request provenance, pagination metadata, explicit empty results, and SHA-256 checksums in a private root.
Generate and verify a cryptographically hashed manifest. Missing, incomplete, or tampered artifacts must fail closed.
Enforce valid timestamp ranges (09:35 to 15:59 ET), unique timestamps, correct symbol identities, and OHLCV validity.
Conservative 15:59 ET liquidation-bar coverage: every selected actionable symbol must possess a valid 15:59 ET liquidation bar to establish path-data readiness without running trade simulations.
Missing 15:59 liquidation bar, invalid payload, or unresolved provider failure strictly prevents USABLE classification.
Legitimate sparse minutes between 09:35 and 15:58 ET are preserved as valid sparse intervals without fabricating prices, fills, stops, or exits.

candidate_screening_gate.interpretation: Evaluates candidate-screening completeness among daily-base-qualified symbols. Legitimate provider-reported absence (NO_OPENING_PRINT_NO_SETUP, UNRANKABLE_ZERO_RV_BASELINE) counts as validly determined. Provider errors, HTTP failures, and malformed bars count against completeness.

operational_safety_bounds.action_on_exceed: STOP before execution and report BLOCKED_RESOURCE_BOUND

pilot_scope.massive_snapshot: ONE complete 2024-01-02 snapshot (active=true, market=stocks, locale=us, terminal pagination required)
